title: Any client can read another company's orders by id
summary: GET /api/orders/{id} returns the full order to a user from a different company.
steps: Sign in over the API as acme-1 (Acme Traders)
POST /api/orders with reference QA-at, 80 x p-102; note the id
Sign in as bright-1 (Bright Foods) and GET /api/orders/{id} (see evidence for the exact request)
Observe HTTP 200 with Acme's order
expected: 403 or 404 for a different company's order
actual: HTTP 200 with the full order body, twice
suspected_cause: Order detail lookup by id without filtering on the caller's client_id (the list endpoint is scoped correctly: the QA- search as bright-1 did not return it)

regression_test.description: Client B GETs client A's order id and expects 403/404

title: Client accounts can list all customer records (admin endpoint unprotected)
summary: GET /api/admin/customers returns 200 with data to client users; only admins should see customers.
steps: Sign in over the API as acme-1, then as bright-1 and acme-2
GET /api/admin/customers
Observe HTTP 200 and the customer list; the sales report on the same prefix correctly returns 403
actual: HTTP 200 with customer records for every client role, twice each
suspected_cause: Missing admin role check on the customers route

regression_test.description: Each client role GETs /admin/customers and expects 403

title: Order tax is calculated on the undiscounted subtotal, so discounted orders are overcharged
summary: For orders at or above 1,000.00 the 5% discount is applied but tax is still 10% of the full subtotal; the rule says tax applies to the discounted subtotal.
steps: Sign in as acme-1 and POST /api/orders with 80 x p-102 (12.50 each): subtotal 1000.00
Expected discount 50.00, tax 95.00, total 1045.00
Observe tax_cents 10000 and total_cents 105000 (1050.00)
Repeat with 81 units: expected total 1058.06, got 1063.12
Same wrong total shown in the Client Portal confirmation (New order, 80 x Ballpoint Pens): 'Total: $1,050.00'
expected: total = subtotal - discount + 10% of discounted subtotal (1045.00)
actual: total 1050.00 (tax on undiscounted subtotal); every order of 1000.00+ is overcharged by 5% of the discount's tax effect. Orders below 1000.00 are correct (987.50 -> 1086.25).
suspected_cause: Tax computed from subtotal_cents instead of subtotal minus discount

regression_test.description: Order of 80 x 12.50 expects tax 9500 and total 104500; 81 x 12.50 expects total 105806

title: Signing out does not revoke the session token
summary: After POST /auth/logout returns 204, the same token still works on GET /me.
steps: Sign in over the API as zain-1
POST /api/auth/logout and observe 204
GET /api/me with the same token
Observe HTTP 200 with the user profile
expected: 401 after logout (rule: signing out ends the session at once)
suspected_cause: Logout does not add the token to a revocation list or the check ignores it

regression_test.description: Logout then GET /me with the same token expects 401

title: Order validation is missing: zero/negative/over-limit/fractional quantities and empty orders are accepted
summary: POST /api/orders accepts quantity 0, -3, 1001 and 1.5 and an empty items list, producing negative or meaningless totals.
steps: Sign in as acme-1
POST /api/orders with items[0].quantity = -3 (and 0, 1001, 1.5), and separately with items: []
Observe HTTP 201 each time; the -3 order appears in My Orders with a negative total
expected: HTTP 400 naming the field (quantity must be a whole number 1..1000; at least one item)
actual: HTTP 201 in every case, twice each

regression_test.description: POST quantities 0,-3,1001,1.5 and empty items expect 400

title: Double submit creates duplicate orders
summary: Two identical simultaneous POST /orders calls both return 201; no duplicate protection. Unsure whether the product intends duplicates, so severity is by user impact.
steps: Sign in as acme-1
Send the same valid POST /api/orders twice in parallel (see evidence)
Observe two 201 responses and two orders
expected: One order or an idempotency/duplicate refusal
suspected_cause: No idempotency key or duplicate-reference check

regression_test.description: Parallel identical POSTs yield one order or a 409

title: Order list returns 500 for page_size=0 and for search q containing ( or \; page_size=-1 is accepted
summary: GET /api/orders crashes on page_size=0 and on q=( / q=\ (likely an unescaped regular expression), and accepts page_size=-1 against the spec minimum of 1.
steps: Sign in as acme-1
GET /api/orders?page_size=0, then ?q=( , then ?q=\
Observe HTTP 500 each time; ?page_size=-1 returns 200
expected: 400 for invalid input; search treats the text literally
actual: HTTP 500 (and 200 for -1), reproduced for client and admin
suspected_cause: Search text compiled as a regex; page size used as a divisor without validation

regression_test.description: GET /orders with page_size=0 and q=( expect 400 / 200, never 500

title: Malformed JSON errors leak stack traces and server file paths
summary: Invalid JSON to /auth/login and /orders returns a 400 body containing a stack trace and source paths.
steps: POST /api/auth/login with a malformed JSON body
POST /api/orders as acme-1 with a malformed JSON body
Observe a stack field and file paths in the error body
expected: A short error message without internals
actual: Stack trace and server paths in the body, twice
suspected_cause: Default error handler serializes the exception stack

regression_test.description: Malformed JSON returns 400 with no 'stack' field or file paths

title: My Orders table overflows and hides its first row on mobile (390px)
summary: At 390x844 the orders table is wider than the screen (right edge about 496px), the Total column is cut off, and the first order row sits under the toolbar.
steps: Sign in to the Client Portal as acme-1
Resize to 390x844
Open My orders
Observe the Total column cut off and the newest order row covered by the Status / New order toolbar
expected: All columns reachable and no row hidden
actual: Totals clipped, first row covered; audit reports covered elements on both loads
suspected_cause: Table not in a scroll container and toolbar overlapping its top

regression_test.description: At 390px the table has no hidden rows and totals visible

title: Sales report endpoint is slow (about 4 seconds)
summary: GET /api/admin/reports/sales consistently takes about 4 s, so the Admin report page shows an empty heading for several seconds.
steps: Sign in as admin
GET /api/admin/reports/sales
Observe ~4000 ms response, repeated

regression_test.description: Sales report responds in under 3000 ms
